poleis <- st_read("C:/Users/30694/Desktop/Διερευνητική Ανάλυση και Οπτικοποίηση Δεδομένων/ergasia_4h/data μέρος β/Poleis_WGS84.shp")

values_poleis <- extract(raster_data, poleis)

# Add the extracted values to the 'poleis' data frame

# Extract altitude values for each 'nomoi'
altitude_values_mean <- extract(raster_data, nomoi, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
altitude_values_sd <- extract(raster_data, nomoi, fun = sd, na.rm = TRUE)


# Calculate average altitude and standard deviation for each 'nomoi'
nomoi$Av_gAltitude <- altitude_values_mean
nomoi$SD_Altitude <- altitude_values_sd

palMean <- colorBin(palette = "viridis", domain = nomoi$Av_gAltitude, bins = 10)
palSd <- colorBin(palette = "viridis", domain = nomoi$SD_Altitude, bins = 10)

```{r}
minAvgAltitude <- floor(min(nomoi$Av_gAltitude, na.rm = TRUE))
maxAvgAltitude <- ceiling(max(nomoi$Av_gAltitude, na.rm = TRUE))
minSdAltitude <- floor(min(nomoi$SD_Altitude, na.rm = TRUE))
maxSdAltitude <- ceiling(max(nomoi$SD_Altitude, na.rm = TRUE))

sliderInput("rangeAvgAltitude",
  label = "Average Altitude:",
  min = minAvgAltitude, max = maxAvgAltitude,
  value = c(minAvgAltitude, maxAvgAltitude)
)

sliderInput("rangeSdAltitude",
  label = "SD of Altitude:",
  min = minSdAltitude, max = maxSdAltitude,
  value = c(minSdAltitude, maxSdAltitude)
)

minValue <- floor(min(points_shapefile$ypsometro1, na.rm = TRUE))
maxValue <- ceiling(max(points_shapefile$ypsometro1, na.rm = TRUE))

sliderInput("rangeValue",
  label = "Value:",
  min = minValue, max = maxValue,
  value = c(minValue, maxValue)
)



       
```

-------------------------------------

### Map


```{r}
nomoiFiltered <- reactive({
  filterAvgAltitude <- nomoi$Av_gAltitude >= input$rangeAvgAltitude[1] & nomoi$Av_gAltitude <= input$rangeAvgAltitude[2]
  filterSdAltitude <- nomoi$SD_Altitude >= input$rangeSdAltitude[1] & nomoi$SD_Altitude <= input$rangeSdAltitude[2]
  nomoi[filterAvgAltitude & filterSdAltitude, ]
})

pointsFiltered <- reactive({
  filterValue <- points_shapefile$ypsometro1 >= input$rangeValue[1] & points_shapefile$ypsometro1 <= input$rangeValue[2]
  points_shapefile[filterValue, ]
})




renderLeaflet({
  filteredNomoi <- nomoiFiltered()
  filteredPoints <- pointsFiltered()

  map <- leaflet() %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    setView(lng = 27.23, lat = 36.56, zoom = 6)

  # Adding Nomoi Polygons
  if (nrow(filteredNomoi) > 0) {
    map <- map %>%
      addPolygons(
        data = filteredNomoi,
        fillColor = ~ colorBin(palette = "viridis", domain = filteredNomoi$Av_gAltitude, bins = 10)(Av_gAltitude),
        color = "white",
        fillOpacity = 0.7,
        label = ~paste0("Name:", NAME, "--", "Average Altitude:", Av_gAltitude, "--", " SD Altitude:", SD_Altitude),
        highlight = highlightOptions(color = "black", bringToFront = TRUE),
        group = "Nomoi"
      )
  }

  # Adding Points Shapefile
  if (nrow(filteredPoints) > 0) {
    map <- map %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        data = filteredPoints,
        radius = 5,  # Fixed radius for visibility
        label = ~ paste0("Υψόμετρο: ", ypsometro1),
        color = "blue",
        fillOpacity = 0.8,
        group = "Points"
      )
  }

  # Add Layers Control
  map <- map %>%
    addLayersControl(
      overlayGroups = c("Nomoi", "Points"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
    )

  map
})






```
